expectations.text: 应用入口安装 @mpxjs/api-proxy，并通过 mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) 明确启用 Promise 风格
expectations.evidence: ./outputs/src/app.mpx:2-7 imports @mpxjs/api-proxy and calls mpx.use(apiProxy, { usePromise: true }) before createApp.

expectations.text: Web 输出中的普通趋势词请求通过会返回 Promise 的 Mpx 官方 API 调用路径使用 await 或 Promise 链；可使用配置后的 mpx.request 或会被跨端编译转换到该入口的 wx.request。原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入不会继承 Promise 化配置，不能直接按 Promise 使用；不得混用 success/fail 回调
expectations.evidence: ./outputs/src/services/search.js:1-6 uses mpx.request(...).then(({ data }) => data) for fetchTrendingKeywords; ./outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:25-26 awaits fetchTrendingKeywords(). No success/fail callbacks or raw api-proxy named import are used for the trend request.

expectations.text: 联想词请求保存可取消任务：可通过单次 usePromise: false 或原始 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入直接取得 RequestTask，也可从已 Promise 化调用的 Promise.__returned 取得框架保留的原始任务；连续搜索与卸载会先废弃当前任务身份再 abort 旧任务
expectations.evidence: ./outputs/src/services/search.js:9-13 returns the mpx.request Promise for suggestions; ./outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:51-54 reads promise.__returned and stores it as requestTask. ./outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:38-42 clears requestTask and increments requestGeneration before aborting the old task, and ./outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:28-30 calls that same cancellation on unload.

expectations.text: 联想词 success/fail 回调捕获本次任务和关键词，仅当前任务且关键词仍匹配时才更新结果或提示，旧响应不能覆盖新搜索
expectations.evidence: ./outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:51-67 captures generation, promise.__returned task, and keyword, then both then and catch guard on this.requestTask === task, this.requestGeneration === generation, and this.keyword === keyword before updating suggestions or showing the error toast.

expectations.text: 详情跳转与错误提示继续走 Mpx 官方 API 链路；可保留会被跨端编译转换的 wx.navigateTo/wx.showToast，可沿用 mpx.xxx，也可在不依赖应用级配置时使用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入
expectations.evidence: ./outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:63-66 uses mpx.showToast for the error prompt, and ./outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx:69-72 uses mpx.navigateTo for product detail navigation.

expectations.text: 不用 fetch、location 或 alert 平行重写 request/navigateTo/showToast；若沿用 @mpxjs/api-proxy 命名导入，应明确这些调用不继承应用入口 mpx.use 的 options/custom/Promise 化配置
expectations.evidence: ./outputs contains no fetch, location, or alert usage. The output no longer imports named request from @mpxjs/api-proxy, so there is no ambiguous reliance on named imports inheriting app-level Promise options.

expectations.text: 趋势词、连续输入、清空搜索、取消旧请求、结果展示和商品详情业务链路保持完整
expectations.evidence: ./outputs/src/pages/search/index.mpx keeps trending display and loading at lines 4-6 and 25-26, continuous input at 32-33, clear behavior at 44-49, old request cancellation at 38-42 and 46, result rendering at 7-8 and update at 56-59, and product navigation at 69-72.

eval_feedback.overall: 全部断言通过；输出满足 Promise 化入口、趋势词请求、可取消联想词请求、防旧响应覆盖、错误提示和详情跳转要求。
